name: OpenAQ
summary: Read open air-quality measurements from the OpenAQ API v3 and from the public OpenAQ S3 archive, month by month, as resumable partitions.

fields.name: api_key
fields.label: API key
fields.help: Sent as X-API-Key to api.openaq.org. The S3 archive needs no key. Store it with ogun secrets set.

auth.label: No key (the public S3 archive only)

notes: Reached through the builtin crawl@1 (locations from the API) and acquire@1 (files from the archive). Terms: attribution to OpenAQ is required, and use must complement rather than replicate OpenAQ. Check the licence again before you rely on it.
